To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we developed a mathematical model of operation for a fiber optic D/A converter based multisensory converter that allows us to analyze the operation of a multisensour converter of binary mechanical signal into electric signals, taking into account its constructive and operational characteristics.

a mathematical model of the fiber optic digital to an analog converter operation is developed; the model is presented in analytical equations for defining an electric code based on mechanical code digits; the conversion of the frequency mechanical signals into codes is considered.
we developed a mathematical model of a fiber optic multisensory converter that allows us to calculate the conversion of mechanical signals into electric signals.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design, mathematical model of operation, and numerical simulation of a multisensor converter of binary mechanical displacements to electric signals.
the development of mathematical models of operation and the numerical analysis of multisensory fiber optic converters of binary mechanical signals into electric codes.
the development of a mathematical model of the operation of a fiber-optic digital to analog converter based multisensory converter for binary mechanical signals to electric signals.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the mathematical model presented in this paper can be used to design and develop multisensory converters, which are based on fiber optic digital to analogue converters, for the conversion of binary mechanical signals into electric signals.
a mathematical model for the operation of a fiber optical digital-to-analog converter has been presented.
the mathematical model of the fiber optic digital to analogue converter operation has been developed.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed mathematical model of operation for fiber optic digital to analogue converters is a useful tool for the design of multisensory converter systems.

a mathematical model of operation was developed for a multisensory device for converting binary mechanical signals into electrical signals, and an algorithm was developed for the numerical calculation of the mathematical model.
the developed mathematical model of the operation of the multisensury converter of binary mechanical signal to electric signals can be used in design and operation of the converter.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the multisensory conversion of mechanical signals into electrical signals is a promising approach to the development of control and monitoring systems for objects with high requirements to the information security and noise immunity.
the developed mathematical model allows one to determine the maximum permissible errors of the converter elements, which ensure the full reliability of its operation.
the developed mathematical model of the device can be used to determine the parameters of its elements to provide the required level of reliability and efficiency of the converter operation.
